title: Remove Background from Image Online – Free, No Upload
description: Remove the background from a photo in your browser: cut out a person or an object as a transparent PNG or on white. Free, nothing is uploaded.
heading: Remove background
subtitle: Cut a person or an object out of a photo, on a transparent or white background; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Remove the background from a photo without sending it anywhere: a small model running in your browser finds the subject and makes everything else transparent, or white. Choose A person for portraits (clean edges around hair and shoulders) or An object or animal for products and pets, compare before and after, and save a PNG. The first time, the model (5 to 7 MB, plus its 15 MB runtime) is loaded from this site and kept by your browser.

features.title: Private
features.text: The cut-out is made on your device; the photo never goes to a server.

features.title: People and objects
features.text: A model made for portraits, and one for products, pets and other subjects.

features.title: Transparent or white
features.text: A transparent PNG for designs, or a white background for listings.

stepsTitle: How to remove the background from a photo

steps.title: Choose your photo
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC photo on the page.

steps.title: Say what it shows
steps.text: Choose A person or An object or animal.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Choose transparent or white and click Remove background.

handles: Portraits and photos of people, with soft edges around hair.
Products, objects and pets on a plain or busy background.
Transparent PNG, or a white background in the photo's own format.
JPG, PNG, WebP and HEIC photos.
limits: The models are small, so they run on your device: fine hair, glass, smoke and busy backgrounds can come out rough.
Each of the two models loads from this site the first time you use it, with the runtime (up to about 22 MB); after that it works offline.

faq.question: Is my photo uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your photo is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Which choice should I pick?
faq.answer: A person for portraits and people; An object or animal for products, pets and anything else.

faq.question: Why are some edges rough?
faq.answer: The models are small enough to run on your device. Fine hair, glass and busy backgrounds are hard for them; a plain background gives the cleanest result.

faq.question: Can I put the subject on another background?
faq.answer: Save a transparent PNG and place it on any background in the Photo editor or a design app.

faq.question: What does the first use download?
faq.answer: The model and the runtime that runs it, up to about 22 MB, from this site itself. Your browser keeps them, so later uses start at once and work offline.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.

faq.question: How do I remove the background from a picture for free?
faq.answer: Use a background remover that finds the subject and makes the rest transparent; on iPhone and Mac you can also touch and hold, or Control-click, the subject of a photo to lift it out (checked 24 November 2026). OpenAnyDoc does it in your browser with a small model on your device and saves a PNG, transparent or white, without uploading the photo.
